name: Flight Simulator Warsaw
summary:
Flight Simulator Warsaw puts you in the captain's seat over the real Warsaw.

THE REAL WARSAW
Real satellite, elevation and map data: the Palace of Culture, Varso Tower, the Warsaw Spire, the Royal Castle and Old Town, the National Stadium, Lazienki, Wilanow, the Temple of Divine Providence and thirteen Vistula bridges. Four airports: Chopin, Modlin, Babice and the Minsk Mazowiecki air base.

A LIVING CITY
Koleje Mazowieckie, the SKM, the Pendolino, the WKD and the trams on their real tracks, cars and buses
